proposal.text: We use five AI-assisted tools in client work. Three of four tools approved for client confidential information do not allow what we enter to be used to train a model. Four of five tools in use have a written review step: a person at the firm reviews the tool's output before anyone relies on it. Every tool in firmwide use that our known-answer test applies to has a passing result on record. We bill for the time our people spend, not for time a tool saved, and add no separate charge for the tools. Three of four tools approved for client confidential information have a check against the client's written terms on AI before use on a matter. Our one-page statement dated 2026-11-25 gives the detail.
